newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Russia's Chernomyrdin to visit Belgium, EU.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Chernomyrdin to visit Belgium, EU.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will visit Belgium from July 17 to 19 to meet Belgian and European Union officials, diplomats said on Thursday.

A European Commission spokesman confirmed the Russian leader would meet Commission president Jacques Santer. Chernomyrdin is expected to discuss co-operation between the EU and Moscow in the field of customs, industry and science.
A Belgian Foreign Ministry spokesman said he had no details of the programme yet.
It was not immediately clear whether Chernomyrdin would meet NATO officials.
Chernomyrdin said earlier on Thursday Moscow still had a negative attitude towards NATO enlargement despite having given in to the alliance's plan to admit members from eastern Europe.

Leaders of NATO states will decide at a summit in Madrid next week which countries to admit, with Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic seen as certainties. U.S. resistance has dampened Romania's and Slovenia's hopes of early membership.
